after.CONFIRMED: on H1 the senior's approval replaces the confidence floor for the agreements it judges, in a new dual-ai version, the owner told first; the lesson check, the risk engine and the always-sure seat rule stay as they are, and its vetoes stay followed forward
after.otherwise: nothing changes; the result is reported as it is

groups.APPROVED: verdict APPROVE with confidence of 50 or more (the live rule's even odds)

spec.measure: net R as followed forward (forward.walk: Trader 1's levels, the H1 time exit, spread, slippage and commission); t of the mean over trades; the same over the UTC days' own mean net R; Welch t of the approved trades' mean minus the rest's
spec.question: on the H1 chart, do the agreements below the confidence floor that the senior trader approved in shadow pay after costs, and beat the ones it did not approve?
spec.reported_never_judged: the share approved, the agreements without a usable review, the senior's reviews of real trade candidates, and CONF-1's units without a review
spec.units: every DUAL_AI_LOW_CONFIDENCE proposal on the H1 chart decided inside the look's window, in the look's partition, whose decision recorded a usable senior shadow verdict (senior_shadow: asked, APPROVE or VETO, a confidence), and whose outcome the ledger recorded as RESOLVED by the look's date (forward_outcomes.ts), each decision once

verdicts.EVALUATION: only after QUALIFIED: CONFIRMED if both groups reach their minimum and every EVALUATION condition holds; INCONCLUSIVE if a group is short; NOT CONFIRMED otherwise
verdicts.LEARNING: QUALIFIED if both groups reach their minimum and every LEARNING condition holds; INCONCLUSIVE if a group is short; FAILED otherwise (EVALUATION is then not judged)
